title: Vegetarian Mediterranean Couscous Bowl
description: A flavorful and nutritious bowl filled with couscous, roasted vegetables, and a tangy tahini sauce.
instructions: In a large bowl, toss the cherry tomatoes, zucchini, and red bell pepper with 1 tablespoon of olive oil, salt, and pepper.
Spread the vegetables on a baking sheet and roast for 20-25 minutes or until tender.
In a medium saucepan, bring 2 cups of water to a boil.
Add the couscous, cover, and turn off the heat. Let it sit for 5-7 minutes or until the water is absorbed.
In a small bowl, whisk together the tahini, lemon juice, and garlic.
To assemble the bowls, divide the couscous among four plates, then top with the roasted vegetables and spoon the tahini sauce over the top.
Drizzle with the remaining 1 tablespoon of olive oil and serve.
